name: EVC Inspection Report Submission Delinquency Escalation
description: Escalates overdue submission of joint inspection report after physical campus inspection is concluded.

tiers.description: Level 1: 24 hours overdue past visit completion. Coordinator calls committee chairman to upload report immediately.
tiers.actionRequired: Contact committee chairman to expedite signed report upload.

tiers.description: Level 2: 48 hours overdue. Formal escalation to Regional Officer and Member Secretary. Inspection panel flagged.
tiers.actionRequired: Notify Member Secretary of committee delinquency.

autoResolutionCondition: Signed EVC joint report uploaded and verified.
